working_title: Apparent island phenotypes in Palmer penguins are compositional and temporally reassembled
one_sentence_claim: Functional differentiation among neighboring Palmer breeding sites is generated mainly by species sorting, while within Adelie penguins island-associated morphology is temporally labile and transfers poorly across years.
ecological_question: Does a persistent within-species island phenotype remain after species turnover is removed, or are island-associated trait differences reassembled among years?

community_scale.source: frozen ODSP Stage-2 Palmer Penguins result imported as provenance only
community_scale.ecological_role: establish that the conspicuous assemblage-level island phenotype is mainly compositional rather than a stable within-species morphology effect

new_extension.classifier: nearest centroid after training-only sex centering and training-only feature scaling
new_extension.within_year_validation: leave-one-individual-out within each year; every heldout individual is classified from same-year training individuals only
new_extension.cross_year_validation: existing leave-one-year-out; heldout year is never used to estimate sex means, scales or island centroids
new_extension.metric: balanced accuracy across the three islands
primary_summary: within-year balanced accuracy by year and mean across years
leave-one-year-out balanced accuracy by heldout year and mean across years

supports_temporal_reassembly_if: primary structural within-year mean balanced accuracy exceeds the frozen one-third chance reference
cross-year structural mean remains near the frozen chance reference
existing sign reversals remain descriptively concordant
persistent_ecotype_support_requires: cross-year structural mean balanced accuracy materially above one-third chance
fixed island effects consistent across years rather than repeated sign reversals
interpretation_rules.reason: three years are too few to turn this post-outcome extension into a confirmatory population-level test; effect size and transfer contrast are primary

central_results_order: assemblage-level island phenotype is dominated by species composition
within Adelie fixed island effects are weak
same-year versus cross-year transfer distinguishes ephemeral spatial structure from persistent island phenotype

boundaries: No individual plasticity claim because individuals are not repeatedly measured.
No causal island habitat mechanism claim.
No claim that isotopes measure local summer island foraging.
No general island-biogeographic law from three islands and three years.
Biscoe Point long-term replacement is contextual assembly evidence and not a replicate of the three Palmer Penguins island sample.
terminal_rule: After the single within-year versus cross-year extension is frozen, no alternate classifier, trait subset, distance metric, year grouping, or rescue analysis may be added to strengthen this lane.
